name: Project Gears 2
description: Gears of War 2 game module for Project Xenon. Project Gears 2 supplies revision-scoped analysis metadata and hook routines for each supported executable (xenon-analysis/); Xenon prepares the native module from the player's own disc and supplies the Xbox 360 runtime, XEX/title-update loader, content, input, audio and Xenos graphics systems.

content.identityPolicy: Fixed-address analysis knowledge is enabled only for verified revision profiles. Europe/Australia retail Media ID 51D281BE (executable version 0x00000007, effective image hash dc3ba9d7eae093ee688946352ef00fc2400f5c89) is the first profile. Its code is byte-identical to the US 0.0.0.5 disc executable COGBox targets (code SHA-1 eb8aedd4567c220176ae4e7d95c89f667a361387), so COGBox disc-build addresses apply unchanged; its Title Update 6 addresses do not.

knownUpdates.label: TU6
knownUpdates.note: COGBox builds against the disc plus Title Update 6. A TU6 effective image needs its own revision profile here before any TU6-scoped address is used.

titleUpdates.policy: Xenon applies and validates XEXP data. Project Gears 2 enables fixed-address hints only for an effective executable with a verified revision profile.
